detaileddescription.para: Controls how the connector advances through pages of results.

listitem.para: OFFSET: Numeric offset/limit style – each page request carries an integer offset that advances by the number of items received. Example URL: ?offset=100&limit=50

briefdescription.para: Abstract interface for Tensor-Train (TT) decomposition used by the ingestion pipeline.

sect2.title: Motivation (SoC / DIP)
sect2.para: The ingestion module must not depend on any concrete tensor-storage backend. Instead it depends only on this lightweight interface. The binding to the real TensorTrainDecomposer (stored in storage/) is performed in the tensor module through TensorIngestionBridge and injected at construction time — the ingestion engine never sees a single storage/ or tensor/ header.

sect2.title: Returned record format
sect2.para: decompose() returns a TensorCoreRecord (defined in extraction_context.h) that wraps the flattened TT-core bytes produced by TTTrain::serialize(). The record also carries provenance metadata from ExtractionContext::manifest so that regulated-industry consumers (FITKO, eJustice) can trace every core back to its source document.

sect2.title: κ-gate (avoid wasteful decomposition)
sect2.para: shouldDecompose() performs a cheap pilot check (Frobenius norm + pilot SVD on a small random sample) and returns true only when the data is expected to achieve a compression ratio κ ≥ min_kappa. The default min_kappa = 1.3 is the boundary identified in research/HNSW_FAISS_TT_BOUNDARY_ANALYSIS.md.
Thread safety: all methods MUST be thread-safe.
Opaque byte blob for one TT-train serialised by TTTrain::serialize().

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-01: Transient errors are correctly classified

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that network timeouts, temporary failures, and resource constraints are classified as transient.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-02: Permanent errors are correctly classified

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that validation errors, configuration errors, and authentication failures are classified as permanent.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-03: Resource exhaustion errors are correctly classified

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that memory, disk, and pool exhaustion errors are properly categorized for resource-specific handling.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-04: Backpressure errors are correctly classified

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that backpressure-inducing errors (saturation, throttling, rate limiting) are properly marked for flow control decisions.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-05: ErrorContext basic serialization to JSON

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that ErrorContext can be serialized to valid JSON with all core fields.
Verifies that ErrorContext supports nested error contexts for error chaining and root cause analysis.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-07: Error message lookup for all error codes

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that getErrorMessage() returns meaningful messages for all error codes, with no empty or truncated messages.

Verifies that error classification results are consistent:
Transient ∩ Permanent = ∅ (mutually exclusive)
ResourceExhaustion ⊆ Backpressure (resource exhaustion implies backpressure)
Verifies that fail-closed policy (CLOSE_ON_DEGRADATION) prevents degraded operation and raises alert.
Verifies that fail-open policy (CONTINUE_WITH_DEGRADATION) allows operation to continue despite errors.
Verifies that defer policy (DEFER_WITH_RETRY_ACCUMULATION) queues operations for later retry.
Verifies that FailSafeContract properly specifies component contract requirements for different failure scenarios.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-13: Diagnostic emitter listener registration and invocation

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that listeners are properly invoked when incidents are emitted, and multiple listeners can be registered independently.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-14: Diagnostic incident categorization from errors

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that errors are correctly categorized into incident types and mapped to appropriate severity levels.

xrefdescription.para: ING3C-15: Diagnostic incident tracking and counters

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the emitter tracks incident counts per category and provides aggregate statistics.
Verifies that incidents can be serialized to JSON for logging, streaming to monitoring systems, and audit trails.
